description: Set the game's live config: any JSON the game reads at runtime (drop rates, prices, difficulty, a banner, feature switches). It reaches rooms that are already running within ~15 seconds, with no redeploy and nobody disconnected; clients read it as mp.live.config, server logic as liveOps().config. Merges by default (a null value deletes a key); replace: true swaps the whole object. Active events' overrides apply on top. Max 8KB.

config.description: JSON object to merge (or, with replace, to store).

game.description: Which game to act on: its publishable key (pk_…) or its exact name. Defaults to the x-mp-game header, then your primary game.

replace.description: Replace the whole config instead of merging (default false).

name: set_live_config
title: Set a game's live config
